title: Convergent evolution of metabolic regulation governs redox adaptation in Toxoplasma
title_zh: Toxoplasma中代谢调控的趋同进化主导红氧还原适应
abstract: Diverse organisms adjust metabolic gene expression during crowding as they encounter nutrient scarcity, oxidative stress, and waste accumulation. Apicomplexan parasites experience these stresses during intracellular growth within host cells yet lack known regulators of metabolic adaptation. We screened the apicomplexan parasite Toxoplasma gondii to identify genes that support parasite fitness during crowding. Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD)(P)+ biosynthesis was required at high parasite density, along with several parasite-specific factors, including an RNA-binding protein we named "T. gondii parasite response to oxidation" (TgPRO). TgPRO loss elevated reactive oxygen species under ambient conditions, which was rescued by growth at low oxygen levels. TgPRO regulates the expression of transcripts involved in carbon metabolism and iron-sulfur cluster assembly. Regulation of the iron-sulfur cluster assembly protein ISCU relies on TgPRO binding to the transcript's 3' UTR. Through convergent evolution, TgPRO performs a role analogous to that of known metabolic regulators from other species, representing the first dedicated regulator of metabolic gene expression in apicomplexans.
abstract_zh: 多种生物在高密度生长下会遇到营养匮乏、氧化胁迫及废物积累等压力，并据此调整代谢基因表达。顶复合体生物（apicomplexan）寄生虫在宿主细胞内寄生增殖时也经历这些应激，但缺乏已知的代谢适应性调控因子。我们对寄生虫Toxoplasma gondii进行了筛选，以确定在拥挤条件下有助于寄生虫适应性（fitness）的基因。烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD(P)+）生物合成在高寄生虫密度下是必需的，并且需要若干寄生虫特异性因子，其中包括一个我们命名为“T. gondii parasite response to oxidation”（TgPRO）的RNA结合蛋白。TgPRO缺失在常氧条件下提高了活性氧（reactive oxygen species, ROS），而在低氧培养下这种现象得到缓解。TgPRO调控参与碳代谢和铁-硫簇（iron-sulfur, Fe-S）装配的转录本表达。Fe-S装配蛋白ISCU的调控依赖于TgPRO结合该转录本的3' UTR。通过趋同进化，TgPRO在功能上与其他物种中的已知代谢调控因子发挥类似作用，代表了首次发现的apicomplexan中专一的代谢基因表达调控因子。
